# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventy-six years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v4 c7 P43](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0043), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (St. Brendan's Island)  <sub>[v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Retired sea captain and lighthouse keeper at Seven Gulls Point  <sub>[v4 c7 P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 c8 P5](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0005), [v4 c9 P27](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0027)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain Saul  <sub>[v4 c6 P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Saul was a tall, stooped, and somewhat awkward man, though he retained an impression of immense physical power and endurance. He had an iron-gray, thick mane of hair that hung down to his shoulders, a closely shaved, bronzed, and heavily furrowed face, a rough mouth, and deep-set, exceptionally blue eyes that could twinkle, dream, or gaze wistfully at the sea. In his final months, he became noticeably frailer, paler, and more stooped.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P3](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0003), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c31 P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016)_

## Personality

Possessing a rare blend of human warmth and deep wisdom, Captain Saul was a gentle, unpretentious, and deeply compassionate man. He harbored an intense love for natural beauty, children, animals, and storytelling, often recounting his adventurous past with vivid charm. Unfailingly polite and hospitable, he was a soulmate to those of like mind and possessed an unshakeable faith in the ultimate goodness of God and the triumph of right. He faced adversity with a quiet, patient humor and possessed a fierce, protective chivalry toward women and the vulnerable.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P3](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0003), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023), [v4 c6 P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031), [v4 c7 P18](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0018), [v4 c7 P41](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0041), [v4 c7 P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 c7 P55](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0055), [v4 c7 P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), [v4 c8 P6](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0006), [v4 c9 P59](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0059)_

## History

Born in Seven Gulls, Saul Garrick felt an early, irresistible urge to go to sea. In his youth, he formed a deep friendship with the schoolmaster John Tremayne and fell in love with a girl named Margaret, whose tragic death at sea left him permanently devoted to her memory. For over fifty years, Captain Saul sailed the globe, surviving mutinies, shipwrecks, and pirate encounters, eventually retiring to become the keeper of the Seven Gulls Point lighthouse. Eleven years before his death, he discovered the amnesiac Laurence Vane in Havana and returned him to Seven Gulls, believing him to be Rufus Vane. In his later years, he became a beloved figure to Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell Harcourt, welcoming them warmly into his life and lighthouse. He befriended young author Adrian Treleaven, allowing him to adapt his cherished 'life-book' into a novel. Shortly after receiving a published copy of his completed book, Captain Saul passed away peacefully at night in his lighthouse, resting his hands upon his life's story.

## Background by volume

- Born in Seven Gulls, originating from a long line of seafaring ancestors on his mother's side  <sub>[v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Spent more than fifty years at sea, traveling to every corner of the world and surviving shipwrecks, mutinies, fires, and pirate attacks  <sub>[v4 c7 P43](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0043), [v4 c9 P45](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0045), [v4 c9 P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046)</sub>
- Tragically lost his young sweetheart, Margaret, to the sea over fifty years prior and remained devoted to her memory for the rest of his life  <sub>[v4 c20 P14](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0014), [v4 c20 P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017)</sub>
- Discovered the amnesiac Laurence Vane in Havana and brought him back home to St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P34](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0034)</sub>
- Maintained a journal and log of his sea adventures, which he called his 'life-book'  <sub>[v4 c9 P20](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0020), [v4 c24 P19](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0019)</sub>

However, mark my words, Winifred, I am convinced that it will ultimately be defeated.  <sub>[v4 c18 P41](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0041)</sub>
